sloka: शङ्खदुन्दुभिसङ्घुष्टः सिंहनादस्तरस्विनाम् ।पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षं च सागरं चैव नादयन् ।। ६.४२.३९ ।।।।
transliteration: śaṅkhadundubhisaṅghuṣṭaḥ siṁhanādastarasvinām ।pṛthivīṁ cāntarikṣaṁ ca sāgaraṁ caiva nādayan ।। 6.42.39 ।।।।

translations.english: By the blast of conchs and roll of drums, and roar of lions of Vanara and Rakshasa forces it resounded all over the earth, sky and up to the ocean.
